<div class="course-syllabus-header">
<div class="course-syllabus-header-main">
<div class="course-page-label">Syllabus</div>
<h1 class="course-page-title">Introduction to R</h1>
<p class="course-page-intro">Learn to explore, analyse and visualise your research data with R</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="course-syllabus">
<section class="course-syllabus-section">
<h2>Abstract</h2>
<p>This training introduces R, a free and widely used programming language
for data analysis and statistics. It is designed for researchers who
work with data, but have little or no programming experience.

Through short demonstrations and hands-on exercises, you learn how to
read data into R, clean and reshape it, summarise it, and create
publication-quality plots. You work with real research data throughout,
and leave with code you can reuse for your own projects.
</p>
<p class="course-syllabus-keywords"><strong>Keywords:</strong> R · Data analysis · Data visualisation · Reproducible research</p>
</section>
<section class="course-syllabus-section">
<h2>Details</h2>
<dl class="course-syllabus-details">
<div><dt>Dates</dt><dd>17 May 2027 – 19 May 2027</dd></div>
<div><dt>Duration</dt><dd>3 days</dd></div>
<div><dt>Delivery</dt><dd>In-person</dd></div>
<div><dt>Location</dt><dd>SciLifeLab, Solna</dd></div>
<div><dt>Language</dt><dd>English</dd></div>
<div><dt>Credits</dt><dd>1.5 hp<br><span class="course-syllabus-note">Whether the credits count towards your degree is decided by your own university.</span></dd></div>
</dl>
</section>
<section class="course-syllabus-section">
<h2>Learning outcomes</h2>
<p>After completing this training, participants will be able to:</p>
<ol class="course-syllabus-outcomes">
<li><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-number"></span><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-text">Use RStudio to write and run R code, and organise your work in projects</span></li>
<li><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-number"></span><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-text">Read data from spreadsheet and text files into R</span></li>
<li><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-number"></span><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-text">Clean, filter and reshape data with the tidyverse</span></li>
<li><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-number"></span><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-text">Summarise data with descriptive statistics</span></li>
<li><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-number"></span><span class="course-syllabus-outcome-text">Create and customise plots with ggplot2</span></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section class="course-syllabus-section">
<h2>Target audience</h2>
<p>Researchers and PhD students in the life sciences who want to analyse their own data, with little or no programming experience.</p>
<p><strong>Expertise level:</strong> Beginner</p>
</section>
<section class="course-syllabus-section">
<h2>Prerequisites</h2>
<div class="course-syllabus-columns">
<div class="course-syllabus-column">
<h3>Knowledge</h3>
<ul>
<li>Basic knowledge of statistics, such as means and standard deviations</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="course-syllabus-column">
<h3>Technical</h3>
<ul>
<li>Your own laptop, with R and RStudio installed (see Preparation)</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="course-syllabus-section">
<h2>Forms of instruction and examination</h2>
<div class="course-syllabus-columns">
<div class="course-syllabus-column">
<h3>Forms of instruction</h3>
<ul>
<li>Short lectures and live coding demonstrations</li>
<li>Hands-on exercises with real research data</li>
<li>Group discussions</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="course-syllabus-column">
<h3>Forms of examination</h3>
<p>Active participation in all sessions, and a short final exercise in which you analyse and plot a dataset of your choice.
</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
